caption: The drawing consists of six distinct objects arranged on a plain, light beige background. In the upper left, there is a small drawstring bag with an embroidered floral design and a rounded base. To its right, in the upper right corner, there is a lace bonnet featuring intricate lace patterns. Centrally placed, there is a lace cape or collar with scalloped edges and floral embroidery, extending outward symmetrically. Directly beneath the cape, slightly to the left, is a cylindrical container or sewing case with a domed top and bottom, embellished with horizontal bands and dotted details. In the lower left, there is another bag, this one with a rounded shape, decorative texture on its surface, and a frilled lace trim at the top edge, tied at the sides with ribbons. In the lower right corner is a parasol with a curved handle, decorated with floral embroidery matching the style seen in the other objects. The linework is primarily in black ink, with slight shading; some areas show faint tones suggesting the transparence of lace or fabric. The name "LILLIAN CAUSEY" appears in block letters in the lower right corner.
title: Costume
